17. And it was told () Thaniar that her father in law came vp into

way that leadeth to Thamnas: becauſe Scla was growne, aud ſhe had
not taken him to her huiband. 15. Whom when Iudas had ſecu. be
ſuppoſed her to be an hariot : tor ihe had couered her face, leit ſhe
